title: Every post gets a two day window
dek: The home mixer sets a maximum post age of 48 hours in its default config.
whatChanged: The home mixer config sets a maximum post age of 48 hours, written as 48 * 60 * 60 seconds. This is a default in the public repo, and live settings can differ.
meaningForCreators: A post has a limited shelf life in the feed, so an idea that lands flat is not a permanent verdict. Rewriting it and posting again later in the week is a fresh try. The number is a default, so use it as a planning guide rather than a promise.
action: Do this: when a post lands flat, rewrite the idea and post again later in the week instead of letting it sit.
